meta.requirement: Explore Starfell Lake (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Medicine Needed
start.text:
''You almost miss him.''

''A small camp tucked between two flat stones near the water's edge, barely visible from the path. A bedroll, a worn pack, a dented pot hanging over the cold embers of a fire that went out some time ago. A man sits hunched beside it, elbows on his knees, staring at the lake's surface.''

''He startles when gravel crunches under your boot.''

Aldous: ''quickly'' I'm not in trouble. ''beat'' Well. I am, a little.

What_kind_of_trouble_.text:
Aldous: My friend Petra, back in Mondstadt. She came down with a fever three days ago. Not the mild sort. ''rubs the back of his neck'' The kind that doesn't break on its own.

''He glances at the dead fire.''

Aldous: An alchemist I know said the tincture needs Slime Concentrate as a reagent. I have everything else already. Willow branches, lake water, the binding agent. All of it, sitting right there. But the slimes around here will not cooperate with me.

''He holds up both hands. Soft hands. A merchant's hands.''

Aldous: I am not a fighter, traveller. I tried. Twice.

choices.label: How much Slime Concentrate do you need?
I can get it for you

How_much_Slime_Concentrate_do_you_need.text:
Aldous: Ten vials. The tincture calls for a full measure or it loses half its potency. ''almost laughs, tired'' I know. I know that's not nothing. I've been out here three days trying to collect half that amount.

''He looks at you directly for the first time.''

Aldous: If you can fight slimes, you'd have ten by afternoon. It might take me another week. Maybe longer.

choices.label: Ten Slime Concentrate. I'll handle it

Ten_Slime_Concentrate__I_will_handle_it.text:
Aldous: ''straightens up, and some of the exhaustion lifts from his face''

Aldous: Really? ''clears his throat'' I mean. Good. That is, yes. Good.

''He moves to the fire and begins stoking the ash back to life with practiced motions.''

Aldous: I'll have everything else ready the moment you're back. The tincture brews in under an hour once we have the reagent. ''quietly'' She's been sick three days already. I would rather not make it four.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Collect 10 Slime Concentrate and return to Aldous at Starfell Lake

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Return to Aldous

Collect_10_Slime_Concentrate_and_return_.text:
''Aldous is on his feet when you round the stones, and the fire is going properly now, a small clay pot hanging over steady orange flames.''

Aldous: You're back. ''he glances at you, then away, trying not to look too hopeful'' Do you have them?

choices.label: Not yet. Still working on it

Not_yet__Still_working_on_it.text:
Aldous: ''nods, hiding any disappointment with reasonable success''

Aldous: Right. Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.

''He settles back down beside the fire and turns the pot by its handle, checking the heat for something that isn't in it yet.''

Aldous: I'll keep everything ready.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Collect 10 Slime Concentrate and return to Aldous at Starfell Lake

Here__Ten_Slime_Concentrate.text:
Aldous: ''takes the concentrate from you quickly, carefully, and counts each piece under his breath''

Aldous: ...Ten. Yes. That is ten.

''He exhales slowly, like something wound very tight has just been allowed to loosen. Then he goes straight to work, measuring, mixing, adding the concentrate last. The lake wind picks up for a moment and he turns his back to shield the flame until it settles again.''

choices.label: How long does it take to brew?

How_long_does_it_take_to_brew_.text:
Aldous: Forty minutes if I don't rush it. ''doesn't look up from the pot'' The concentrate needs to reduce properly or the tincture goes bitter. ''beat'' I learned that the hard way. Once.

''He stirs in slow circles.''

Aldous: She is going to be fine. ''it sounds like something he has been saying to himself for three days'' People get fevers. They get better. Petra will get better.

''The pot begins to steam. The smell is sharp and medicinal, not unpleasant.''

choices.label: Who's going to bring it to her?

Who_s_going_to_bring_it_to_her_.text:
''Aldous pauses mid-stir. He doesn't answer right away.''

Aldous: ...About that. ''carefully'' I cannot leave this camp until morning. I have a trade contact coming through at first light with goods I cannot simply leave unattended, and if I miss them—

''He stops. Tries again.''

Aldous: I need someone to carry the tincture to Mondstadt tonight. ''meets your eyes'' I know I have already asked a great deal of you.

I_will_take_it.text:
''Aldous lifts the finished tincture off the heat and seals it in a small clay vial. He ties the stopper with a cord, twice, then checks it a third time.''

Aldous: Corner of the craftsmen's district. Blue door. She'll know what it is the moment she sees the vial.

''He places it in your hands.''

Aldous: Tell her I'm fine. Tell her I'll be back by tomorrow evening. ''a quiet pause'' And tell her I'm sorry it took this long.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver Aldous's medicine to Petra in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver the Medicine to Petra

Deliver_the_Medicine_to_Petra.text:
''The blue door is not hard to find. You knock, and after a moment it opens.''

''A young woman stands in the doorway, a blanket around her shoulders despite the mild evening, cheeks still flushed. But her eyes are sharp and clear.''

Petra: ''looking at the vial'' He actually did it.

''She lets out one short, quiet laugh. The relief in it is not quiet at all.''

Petra: Please, come in. You must have carried this all the way from Starfell Lake.

choices.label: He said he'll be back by tomorrow evening

Medicine_Needed__Medicine_Delivered.title: Medicine Delivered
Medicine_Needed__Medicine_Delivered.text:
Petra: ''taking the vial with both hands'' Tomorrow. ''shakes her head, something fond in it'' Of course he waited until the very last moment to ask for help. Three days, I bet. Was it three days?

''You think back to the cold embers, the untouched pack, the exhausted eyes.''

Petra: ''sighing softly'' Of course it was.

''She crosses to a small table near the window and returns with a folded note.''

Petra: He keeps a standing arrangement at the guild counter for anyone who helps him out. ''presses it into your hand'' He'll argue it isn't enough. He's right, probably. But it's what he set aside, and he'd want you to have it.

''She looks at the vial in her other hand.''

Petra: Thank you, traveller. Really.
